analysis_scope: static comparison of the embedded giflib-style GIF decoder and its DGifSlurp allocation path
not_claimed: That the APK contains a uniquely identified giflib release.
That the reviewed CVEs are exploitable or absent under every malformed GIF input.
That GIF-003 is a demonstrated out-of-bounds write.

observed_lzw_checks.instruction: B.GT loc_2ACC3C after comparing StackPtr with 0xFFF
observed_lzw_checks.interpretation: The saved pixel stack is rejected before it is drained when its index is above the 4095-entry table.

observed_lzw_checks.instruction: CMP W3, #0x1000; B.GT loc_2ACD40; ADD W3, W3, #1
observed_lzw_checks.interpretation: The input loop stops increasing RunningCode once it is above 4096. In the observed control flow this keeps the later RunningCode - 2 table index at or below 4095.

observed_lzw_checks.instruction: CMP index, #0xFFF followed by B.GT before table loads
observed_lzw_checks.interpretation: The dictionary and suffix accesses in the main trace loop have explicit upper-bound branches before dependent loads.

observed_lzw_checks.instruction: 0xFFF checks and a 0x1000 iteration counter surround Prefix walks
observed_lzw_checks.interpretation: Malformed dictionary chains are bounded by both an index check and a finite walk count before Prefix is read again.

observed_lzw_checks.instruction: CMP StackPtr, #0xFFE followed by B.GT before stack writes
observed_lzw_checks.interpretation: The decoder rejects a full pixel stack before adding more decoded suffix bytes.

observed_slurp_hardening_gap.assessment: The path has no application pixel or cumulative decoded-byte budget. Its 32-bit arithmetic should be treated as a hardening gap even though this static pass does not demonstrate a memory corruption primitive.
observed_slurp_hardening_gap.instruction: DGifSlurp multiplies width and height in W20, sign-extends the 32-bit result for reallocarray, and separately multiplies width by a row index in W3 before sign-extending the offset.

overall_assessment: The current ARM64 GIF LZW helper is not statically assigned any of the three reviewed upstream CVEs. Its visible bounds checks make the two 2018 dictionary-index patterns less likely to be present, but the exact giflib release is unknown and no malformed-image fuzzing was performed. GIF-003 remains an independent resource and integer-arithmetic hardening item.

upstream_context.affected_versions: giflib 3.0 through 3.1.1 are listed by NVD
upstream_context.comparison: The current body has explicit 0xFFF checks around the observed dependent dictionary loads. The exact giflib release and malformed-input behavior remain unproven.
upstream_context.description: NVD describes a heap buffer overflow in DGifDecompressLine caused by an unchecked CrntCode array index.

upstream_context.affected_versions: giflib 3.0 through 3.1.1 are associated with the record
upstream_context.comparison: The current body caps RunningCode growth at the 0x1000 boundary and caps the pixel stack before writes. This is evidence against a direct copy of the vulnerable pattern, not proof that all decoder states are safe.
upstream_context.description: MITRE describes a heap buffer overflow in DGifDecompressLine caused by an unchecked Private->RunningCode - 2 index.

upstream_context.comparison: No direct zero-height divider was identified in the current DGifSlurp body. The body does contain the separate unchecked 32-bit dimension multiplication recorded as GIF-003.
upstream_context.description: NVD describes a divide-by-zero in DGifSlurp for a malformed GIF with an ImageSize height of zero in GIFLIB before 2019-02-16.
